item.description:
Tea Tree Green Body Wash
3-Step Body Care for Acne-Prone Skin

🟢 Main Points
➰ Step 1: Exfoliation & Pore Care
Removes dead skin cells and unclogs pores for smooth, clear skin.
➰ Step 2: Oil & Sebum Control
Controls excess oil and sebum, minimizing body breakouts and maintaining a healthy moisture balance.
➰ Step 3: Acne-Prone Skin Improvement
Targets blemishes and rough skin for visibly improved, healthier-looking skin.

🟢 Premium Ingredients
➰ Tea Tree Oil & Tea Tree Extract:
Soothes irritation, calms the skin, and refines texture for acne-prone and sensitive skin.
➰ Teflose™ 1,000ppm:
Patented anti-acne ingredient known for reducing blemishes and eliminating body odors—perfect for full-body care.
➰ AC Green Complex for Balanced & Clear Skin:
A blend of AHA, BHA, PHA, green tea, and menthol gently exfoliates, controls excess oil, and prevents breakouts while keeping skin hydrated.
➰ Plant-Based Cleansing Formula:
Castile soap base from coconut and palm—naturally derived, gentle yet effective cleansing.

🟢 Clinical Results
➰ 95% reported fewer breakouts
➰ 95% less excess oil and impurities
➰ 100% improvement in exfoliation
➰ 100% significant odor reduction
➰ 95% smoother skin texture

🟢 Certifications
➰ Clinically tested for acne-prone skin
➰ Dermatologist-tested, safe for sensitive skin
➰ UK Vegan Certified
➰ German DermaTest™ Approved

🟢 Recommended For
➰ Body acne and breakouts
➰ Rough, itchy, or unbalanced skin
➰ Those seeking gentle exfoliation and hydration
➰ Odor caused by excess sebum

🟢 How to Use
➰ Lather onto hands or a towel, gently massage over body, rinse thoroughly.
